text:
maria: Quick check — hitting a weird auth/namespace issue when streaming with the JS SDK across two orgs. Using a service account from org-A to impersonate into a proj in org-B, streams sometimes return 401 on reconnect :eyes:
ajay: hmm. is this the sdk-auth v2 flow or the old jwt flow? any code snippet?
sam: usually that smells like audience/aud mismatch on reconnects. SDK caches the token with the original aud and then tries to reuse it after a reconnect.
maria: using sdk-auth v2 + `impersonate()` wrapper. snippet: ```js
const client = new RedwoodAuth({});
await client.impersonate({serviceAccount: 'svc@org-A.iam', targetProject: 'org-B-proj'});
// open streaming socket
```
lisa: when you call impersonate are you passing `target_project` into the OIDC audience override? we found that needs to be `//iam.googleapis.com/projects/PROJECT_NUMBER/serviceAccounts/EMAIL` in some flows.
maria: I was passing `projects/PROJECT_ID/...` — switching to project number now to test.
ajay: also check that the token cache key includes the audience. If not, you can get stale token reuse. In node SDK we added a quick fix: cache key = `${audience}:${svcAcctEmail}:${scopeHash}`.
sam: another gotcha — streaming reconnects use a short-lived prefetch token for the websocket handshake (different aud) vs the main request. If your impersonation path doesn't mint that prefetch aud, the ws handshake fails on reconnect.
maria: good call. any one-off workaround while we patch?
lisa: you can force `realtime: {reuseTokens: false}` on the client config to always fetch fresh tokens on reconnects. Temporary perf hit but unblocks.
ajay: opened a tiny PR with a test that repros the mismatch and a toggle to force fresh tokens: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789 :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks! testing now. if this works i'll add the project-number aud and flip the reuseTokens flag in prod for that customer.
devex-bot: Note: sdk-auth v2 deprecation notice scheduled 2026-04-01 — see #announcements for migration guide.
maria: one last q — if we switch to project-number aud, do we need to update any L7 routing rules?
ajay: nope, routing uses model & tenant tags, aud is only validated by IAM at mint time. Just confirm the service account can impersonate the target SA.
maria: sweet. pinging if I need a quick review on the PR. thanks all :heart:
